kill_before_durable_interpretation: COUNTING ARTIFACT UNLESS END-END REPRODUCED: this metric is read immediately BEFORE the SIGKILL, and LangGraph commits super-step checkpoints on a background executor, so a not-yet-visible reading here does not mean the commit was lost. 'commit_landed_during_kill_window' counts how many of these hits the post-kill read shows were commits landing inside the measurement gap. Only 'end_to_end_reproductions' is ground truth.
